# Wise Women Use AI

> Claude-specific AI education for women entrepreneurs over 40.
> Warm, practical teaching that works around brain fog and real life,
> not hustle culture.

Founded by Kelly, a British-Australian solopreneur based in Melbourne.
WWUAI is not another ChatGPT course. It teaches Claude specifically,
with a focus on simple systems women can actually stick to.

## Start here
- [Homepage](https://wisewomenuseai.com/): Overview and free Claude guide signup
- [Switch to Claude](https://wisewomenuseai.com/switch): Free guide for ChatGPT users moving to Claude
- [Claude Starter Kit](https://wisewomenuseai.com/starter): Free starter resources for brand-new Claude users

## Community
- [Skool Community](https://wisewomenuseai.com/community): Paid community with live coaching and done-with-you workflows

## Work with me
- [Work With Me](https://wisewomenuseai.com/work): 1:1 AI setup and done-with-you systems builds

## Writing
- [Blog and Newsletter](https://wisewomenuseai.com/blog): Substack archive and weekly posts
